item.title: [IGNITE-8886] Simultaneous using of BinaryWriter и BinaryRawWriter leads to BinaryObjectException and OOM

The workaround here - do not use BinaryWriter и BinaryRawWriter simultaneously.
item.summary: Simultaneous using of BinaryWriter и BinaryRawWriter leads to BinaryObjectException and OOM

status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.

comments.comment:
I've forgot to mention that we only observe this issue when the collection size is greater than 1.

It works fine when there is only a single entry in the collection.
